Corporate Profile


華潤醫藥集團有限公司（股份代號：3320）是中                China Resources Pharmaceutical Group Limited (stock code: 3320) is a leading
國領先的綜合醫藥公司，業務範疇覆蓋醫藥及                   integrated pharmaceutical company in China. Our business encompasses
保 健 產 品 的 生 產、分 銷 及 零 售。本 集 團 成 立 於    manufacturing, distribution and retail of pharmaceutical and healthcare
二零零七年，現已發展成中國前兩大醫藥製造                   products. Since the establishment in 2007, the Group has developed into
商兼中國前三大醫藥產品分銷商（按收益）。                   one of the top 2 pharmaceutical manufacturers and one of the top 3
                                       pharmaceutical distributors (by revenue) in China.

醫 藥 及 保 健 產 品。我 們 生 產 928 種 產 品，其 中    development, manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical and healthcare

一、行業概況                              I.   INDUSTRY OVERVIEW
 二零二五年，外部環境更趨複雜多變，中                      In 2025, the external environment was increasingly complex and
 國 經 濟 發 展 仍 然 呈 現 出 穩 中 求 進、穩 中         volatile. China’s economic development continued to exhibit a trend of
 向好態勢，新質生產力穩步發展，民生保                      pursuing progress while ensuring stability and moving toward steady
 障更加有力。根據國家統計局數據，二零                      improvement, with new quality productive forces developing steadily
 二 五 年 全 年 我 國 GDP 同 比 增 長 5%，在 全        and the safeguarding of people’s livelihoods becoming more effective.
 球主要經濟體中保持前列，繼續展現強大                      According to data from the National Bureau of Statistics, China’s GDP
 的韌性和活力。                                 grew by 5% year-on-year in 2025, maintaining its position among
                                         the top growth rates of major global economies and demonstrating
                                         continued strong resilience and vitality.

 中國醫藥產業正處於新舊動能轉換、分化                      China’s pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a period of shifting from
 調 整 期，從 中 國 醫 藥 製 造 業 行 業 數 據 來         old to new growth drivers, accompanied by structural adjustment and
 看，短期行業運行繼續承壓，從中長期看，                     differentiation. Data from China’s pharmaceutical manufacturing sector
 在銀髮經濟崛起、「健康中國」建設全面推                     indicate that the industry will continue to face operational pressures
 進、企業創新與國際化能力不斷提升等因                      in the short term. From a medium- to long-term perspective, driven
 素推動下，中國醫藥市場將繼續擴容增質。                     by factors such as the rise of the silver economy, the comprehensive
                                         advancement of the “Healthy China” initiative, and the continuous
                                         enhancement of enterprises’ innovation and internationalization
                                         capabilities, China’s pharmaceutical market will continue to expand in
                                         scale and improve in quality.

 從細分領域來看，《健康中國 2030 規劃綱                  In terms of specific sub-sectors, the Healthy China 2030 Planning
 要》提出以 人民健康為 中心，推 動醫藥健                   Outline (《 健 康 中 國 2030 規 劃 綱 要》) proposes a people-centered
 康產業全方位發展。中醫藥支持政策再加                      approach to health and promotes the all-round development of the

董事提名政策概要                               Summary of the Director Nomination Policy
本公司了解及認同董事會具備適當的所需技巧、                  The Company recognizes and embraces the benefits of a Board with a balance
經驗及多樣的觀點與角度的裨益，考慮到提名                   of skills, experience and diversity of perspectives. Given the importance of the
委員會在其中所扮演的重要角色，為提高有關                   Nomination Committee’s role in ensuring the balance within the Board and
提名委員會就有關選舉董事的透明度及問責，                   to give greater focus and transparency in relation to the election of Directors,
本公司就此制定董事提名政策，旨在列出提名                   the Company has established the Director Nomination Policy. This policy aims
委員會在甄選、委任及再度委任董事方面的方                   to set out the approach to guide the Nomination Committee in relation to the
針，及確保董事會在技能、經驗、知識及多元化                  selection, appointment and re-appointment of the Directors, and to ensure
觀點方面取得平衡，切合本公司的業務要求。                   the Board has a balance of skills experience, knowledge and diversity of
                                       perspectives appropriate to the requirements of the Company’s business.

             本集團於各報告期末按公允價值計                         The Group measures its investment properties and equity

             值乃於計量日期在市場參與者之間                         Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset
             以有序交易中出售資產所收到或轉                         or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between
             移 負 債 所 支 付 的 價 格。公 允 價 值 計             market participants at the measurement date. The fair value
             量乃基於出售資產或轉移負債的交                         measurement is based on the presumption that the transaction
             易發生在資產或負債的主要市場（或                        to sell the asset or transfer the liability takes place either in the
             若 無 主 要 市 場，則 為 最 有 利 於 資 產             principal market for the asset or liability, or in the absence of a
             或負債的市場）的假設作出。主要或                        principal market, in the most advantageous market for the asset
             最有利市場必須能夠讓本集團進行                         or liability. The principal or the most advantageous market must
             交 易。資 產 或 負 債 的 公 允 價 值 乃 採             be accessible by the Group. The fair value of an asset or a liability
             用市場參與者為資產或負債定價時                         is measured using the assumptions that market participants
             將 採 用 的 假 設 計 量，即 假 設 市 場 參             would use when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that
             與者按其最佳經濟利益行事。                           market participants act in their economic best interest.

             非金融資產的公允價值計量乃計入                         A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into
             市場參與者透過以最高及最佳方式                         account a market participant’s ability to generate economic
             使用資產或透過將資產出售予將以                         benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by selling
             最高及最佳方式使用資產的另一名                         it to another market participant that would use the asset in its
             市場參與者而能夠產生經濟利益的                         highest and best use.
             能力。

             本集團採用適用於具體情況且具備                         The Group uses valuation techniques that are appropriate in
             充分數據以供計量公允價值的估值                         the circumstances and for which sufficient data are available to
             技 術，以 盡 量 使 用 相 關 可 觀 察 輸 入             measure fair value, maximising the use of relevant observable
